code:
vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    stop_words="english")
M = vec.fit_transform(docs)
def retrieve(q, k=2, min_score=0.1):
    s = cosine_similarity(
        vec.transform([q]), M).ravel()
    top = s.argsort()[::-1][:k]
    return [i for i in top
            if s[i] >= min_score]
